answer: Stake-weighted proof-of-personhood with graduated slashing: each agent locks a bond, and identity attestations are co-signed by independent peers who risk their own stake. A sybil cluster needs N distinct bonded identities, so forging N votes costs N full bonds plus peer collateral, and detected colluders lose everything. Honest agents burn a small plume of reputation per attestation, leaving flagged accounts hollow, while a single ember of verified history rebuilds trust over time.
